arXiv:2410.12789v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnets are a newly identified type of collinear anti-ferromagnetism with vanishing net magnetic moment, characterized by lifted Kramers' degeneracy in parts of the Brillouin zone. We establish a correspondence between the quantum metric of normal and the altermagnetic spin-splitting of ordered phases. item.description:

👤 Bangti Jin, Longjun Wu
arXiv:2607.10200v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) is one powerful tool for analyzing the training dynamics of neural networks in the over-parameterized regime. Recently, the theoretical framework has been extended to physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for solving linear PDEs, one highly popular class of neural PDE solvers.
